# Woodcutting

5 methods train Woodcutting, from wiki/world/methods.ts. Every XP/hr is the floor: the tick-perfect rate, not a forecast ([README](README.md) says what each column means). XP/hr is game XP, the server's XP rate (x25) included; gp/hr is the products kept at item value (obj `cost`); Supplies/hr is how many of each supply an hour uses, and their gp value.

Min is the level the whole method needs, every skill of it at that level together; a level column has Woodcutting at that level and every other skill at it or at the method's own level of it, whichever is higher, with the best axe usable there, and `-` under the method's Woodcutting level. gp/hr, the binding term and Supplies/hr are at 99. Measured is a bot's XP/hr at the level its runs started at, and in brackets it over the floor there. Below the table, each method: what it requires, its sink, its supplies, and who measured it.

- `oak-draynor-drop`: Oaks north of Draynor, dropped. Plans: oak-draynor-drop. The five oaks of tree:draynor-village:1, each log dropped as cut. Every oak site ties on a drop sink (no legs); this one is near the spawn. The plan chops the normal trees of the same cluster to 15 first, area (3095,3283) r16 (bbox 3084-3106 x 3275-3290 plus margin). The south cluster (tree:draynor-village:2) is out: the jail guards attack through the fence there (learnings/hazards.md). Runs: conductor3 2026-10-24, south site, steel axe, WC 15-50 in 143.6 s, ~775k/h; conductor3w1 2026-10-24, north site, adamant axe, WC 68-74, ~1.1M/h chopping (984k/h with the walk in), no attacks.
